title: Ministries — Baker Road Baptist Church
metaDescription: Children's and student ministry, adult Bible study, men's and women's ministry, the Care Ministry and the Pumpkin Patch at Baker Road Baptist Church in Baytown.
headline: Places to belong.
intro: Every one of these will make room for one more. If you are not sure where you fit, call the office and ask.

items.title: Children's Ministry
items.body: A safe place to learn how much God loves them, and real confidence for parents about who is watching their children.

items.title: Student Ministry
items.body: Teaching, games, and adults who know their names.

items.title: Adult Bible Study
items.body: Rooted and Grounded on Sunday mornings. Wednesday nights go deeper.

items.title: Men's Ministry
items.body: Breakfast, service projects, and the plain work of sharpening one another.

items.title: Women's Ministry
items.body: The Ladies Bible Fellowship class, open to women of every age and stage, with fellowship and service events through the year.

items.title: Care Ministry
items.body: This is the one to call when you need something. Rides to church for anyone without a way to get here. Hospital and hospice visits. Meals for a family in a hard week. Prayer when someone is grieving or quietly struggling. And help for neighbors in Baytown who are up against it, whether or not they attend here.

items.title: The Pumpkin Patch
items.when: See the events page for this year's dates
items.body: For a few weeks every fall the church lot becomes a pumpkin patch, open to all of Baytown. Come pick out a pumpkin. That is the whole invitation — no service, no sign-up, nobody to talk to.
